sources.summary: In a rapidly evolving digital landscape autonomous tools and robots are becoming commonplace. sources.title: CoHRT: A Collaboration System for Human-Robot Teamwork

sources.title: Human-Robot collaboration in surgery: Advances and challenges towards autonomous surgical assistants
sources.summary: Human-robot collaboration in surgery represents a significant area of research, driven by the increasing capability of autonomous robotic systems to assist surgeons in complex procedures. This systematic review examines the advancements and persistent challenges in the development of autonomous surgical robotic assistants (ASARs), focusing specifically on scenarios where robots provide meaningful and active support to human surgeons.
